PlaceDetails.description:
A place as stored in the Firestore `googlePlacesCache` collection.

Documents written by the legacy Cloud Functions have no `name`, `locality` or `photoNames`; those are refreshed from Google once and rewritten in this shape. `addressComponents`, `photoMetadata` and `geohash` are kept for the legacy readers of the collection.
